category: 分布式实验任务提交器

分布式实验任务提交器
device_entry.description: 这是一个非物理的软件组件，用于实验相关的数据处理与集群任务编排。它负责在规则触发前准备元数据和提交参数、提交规则任务、跟踪任务进度、等待任务完成，并在结束后执行清理。结合派生类可用于配方处理、本地化分析以及实时数据完成后的后处理流程，也可配合监视器在 Jupyter 笔记本中显示规则进度。
device_entry.description_en: This is a non-physical software component for experiment-related data processing and cluster task orchestration. It prepares metadata and submission arguments before a rule is triggered, posts rule tasks, tracks progress, waits for completion, and performs cleanup afterward. Via derived classes it can support recipe processing, localization analysis, and end-of-data post-processing, and it can be used with watchers to display rule progress in Jupyter notebooks.

schema.description: 准备规则触发前所需的元数据和提交参数。
schema.description_en: Prepare metadata and submission arguments needed before the rule is triggered.

schema.description: 在底层数据完成后执行收尾处理，例如写入采集结束事件。
schema.description_en: Run end-of-data handling when the underlying data is complete, for example writing end-of-acquisition events.

schema.description: 创建所需文件并提交规则；如果数据尚未全部可用，则轮询并继续释放新任务。
schema.description_en: Create required files and post the rule; if all data is not yet available, poll and continue releasing new tasks.

schema.description: 清理规则执行相关的资源或临时内容。
schema.description_en: Clean up resources or temporary content related to rule execution.
Query the current status of the rule.

schema.description: 等待规则相关任务结束。
schema.description_en: Wait for rule-related tasks to finish.

schema.description: 监视规则进度并持续更新显示或状态。
schema.description_en: Watch rule progress and continuously update the display or status.
